subject: design/workbench-ui-v1
statement: Search runs over the reader's records in memory, rebuilt only when the tree fingerprint moves (DINV-5): a query is first tested against the anchor-ID grammars (requirement rows, principles, invariants, incidents, record anchors, review findings) — hits are exact-match results ranked first (PRD FR-3); the remainder is a plain case-folded token scan over titles, headings, and body text with heading-level context and open-at-match anchors. At the PRD's corpus bound (a thousand documents) a full rescan fits the budgets (NFR-1); nothing smarter ships until evidence says the budget breaks (no ranking heuristics, no dependencies).
